definitions.explanation: Admitting defeat or yielding to an opponent or difficult situation. Used both in serious military/competitive contexts and in everyday situations where one gives up trying. Composed of 降 (descend, surrender) + 参 (go, come — humble).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{降参|こうさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}して→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{解|と}けない→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦とうとう→とうとう：00900_toutou⟧{降参|こうさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I finally gave up on the problem that I couldn't solve no matter how many times I tried.

notes:
USAGE:
{降参|こうさん} can express both literal surrender (in battle, competition) and figurative giving up (to heat, difficulty, a persistent person). In casual speech, ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{降参|こうさん}だ！ is a common way to express that one has had enough.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {降参|こうさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to surrender, to give in)
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{降参|こうさん}だ (I give up already)
- {降参|こうさん}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make someone give in)
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降参|こうさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be defeated by the heat)
